description: Lift an active timeout from a member early. It puts someone a moderator silenced back in the conversation, so it needs confirming: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview and a confirm_token, and repeating the call with the token makes the change. A member who is not timed out is left alone, with nothing to confirm.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

reason.description: The reason recorded in the server's audit log.

name: remove_timeout
title: Remove timeout
